provenance.directReviewDefinition: The documenting agent opened the official page with the web tool and read the returned page text.
provenance.indexedReviewDefinition: The documenting agent read official-domain text returned by web search; this is not a claim that every interactive element or underlying live page loaded.
provenance.parentReviewDefinition: The documenting agent read the current root-authored dataset/article and parent verification instructions. Items so marked were not independently reopened in this review.
provenance.noCustomerActions: No account, order, cancellation, move request, address lookup with customer data, or phone call was performed.

sources.title: CPUC: Consumer Information on CCAs
facts: The parent task cites this official page for CCA generation procurement versus the utility's transmission/distribution, metering, billing and outage responsibilities.
limitations: This documenting agent read the source reference and supporting description in guides-utilities.ts, not the page body in this review.

sources.title: ABAG: How We Govern
facts: The parent task cites this page for the nine-county Bay Area scope and 101 incorporated cities and towns.
limitations: The count is the directory's jurisdiction scope, not a claim that a utility serves every address in each city.

sources.title: California Interactive Broadband Map
facts: The parent task recorded that the map displayed coverage data as of 2024-12-31 when checked on 2026-10-02.
The guide uses it as an initial address lookup and requires confirmation with the provider for the full address and unit.
limitations: 2024-12-31 is the dataset vintage reported by the parent, not the verification date.
A provider-reported map does not guarantee an available port, in-building wiring, capacity, installation permission or appointment.
This agent did not submit an address or inspect the live map layers.

sources.title: PG&E: Start, Stop or Transfer Service
facts: Official residential start/stop/transfer route.
The parent independently confirmed 1-877-660-6789 as the preferred current residential account-service contact.

limitations: The account-holder-change detail was reviewed in the parent's article/source description; this agent's prior own page review focused on the account-service route.
No account application was submitted and no identity, fee or processing-time guarantee was inferred.

sources.title: PG&E: Contact Us

sources.title: WestLight Energy: July 1, 2026 name-change release
facts: Release is dated July 1, 2026; bills begin showing the WestLight name from July 17.
This is a name change, not evidence that residents must open a second distribution account.

sources.title: Mint: Keep Existing Service Active Before Number Transfer
facts: Parent cites Mint's instruction to keep the old service active until transferring the number.
limitations: This source is a number-porting instruction; it should not be substituted for a universal home-internet cancellation policy.

sources.title: Etheric Networks Support
facts: Parent's current data records support@ethericnetworks.com and the official support route.
Fixed-wireless service and installation need address/site evaluation.

sources.title: Starlink Support

limitations: No customer-service phone was independently verified here, so none is added.
Omitting a number does not assert that Starlink never offers phone or callback support.
Support options may depend on country, account and product; no signed-in flow was tested.

generalRoutingDecisions.decision: Treat a city directory as a routing aid, not address-level availability.
generalRoutingDecisions.boundary: City limits, mailing city, utility district boundaries, unit wiring, shared meters and provider installation conditions can differ.

generalRoutingDecisions.decision: Ask renters/property managers who holds each account before requesting a change.
generalRoutingDecisions.basis: Editorial workflow synthesis informed by city utility directories and shared-account warnings; not a claim that every lease includes or excludes utilities.
generalRoutingDecisions.boundary: The source article correctly avoids saying every tenant can open or modify a water or waste account; sewer billing may be separate.

generalRoutingDecisions.decision: Separate CCA generation from distribution/account setup.
generalRoutingDecisions.boundary: Palo Alto, Santa Clara, Alameda and Healdsburg municipal electricity should follow their city contacts. Gas arrangements require separate confirmation.

generalRoutingDecisions.decision: Keep home-internet technical, billing, sales and mobile support functions labeled.
generalRoutingDecisions.boundary: The same brand or underlying mobile network does not imply the same account-support team.

generalRoutingDecisions.decision: Keep the existing mobile service active while transferring a number.
generalRoutingDecisions.boundary: Do not apply that mobile-porting rule indiscriminately to all home-internet contract cancellations.

accessLimits: No program tests, deployment or live account flows were run as part of this source-record task.
Official Xfinity contact page required JavaScript in direct extraction; official alternate articles support the two phone categories.
T-Mobile English contact extraction was limited; its official Spanish contact page supplies phone classifications.
CPUC map data vintage 2024-12-31 is explicitly retained as parent-observed metadata, not silently presented as 2026 coverage data.
Consumer Cellular is documented as a dynamic-page limitation. Starlink and US Mobile have no verified number in this record, so no number is inferred.
Visible's no-phone statement is supported by an explicit official contact article, unlike cases where a phone simply was not verified.
Linked availability/moving pages marked parent-verified were not all independently reopened; no exhaustive link-health or address-coverage test is claimed.
Telecom URLs and labels reflect the current files read for this record; later parent edits may update the product text without changing this provenance.
